name: Xenios Orders Payments and Fulfillment

outputSha.source: git rev-parse HEAD after the handoff commit
outputSha.note: A commit cannot contain its own SHA. The exact output SHA is returned beside this file.

scope: supplier handoff queue and explicit release
hardInvariants: A new workflow can only begin in request_pending with no approval.
Invoice issuance requires a named admin approval.
Payment evidence must match the order invoice and is not payment verification.
Settlement requires committed verification evidence matching the invoice amount and currency.
Supplier handoff requires both approval and committed settlement.
A queued supplier handoff cannot begin fulfillment until a separate named release exists.
Fulfillment requires approval, settlement, and supplier release at both domain and storage layers.
Shipped requires append-only tracking; delivered requires shipped evidence.
Personal and business customer reads are ownership-scoped; business reads also require active organization authority.
Customer timelines omit proof object references, supplier payloads, external transactions, settlements, and internal audit details.
Consequential queue/ask actions require a Trust Dial approval reference; never refuses the action.
Identical idempotency retries replay; changed payloads under the same scoped key conflict and are audited.

artifacts.purpose: Unmounted reference workflow extending existing manual-payment commit evidence into approval, settlement, supplier release, fulfillment, tracking, ownership, timeline, idempotency, and audit.
Seven end-to-end and adversarial domain tests.
Unrun storage draft with forced RLS, personal/business ownership, customer-scoped timeline RPC, immutable evidence, and non-bypassable workflow gates.
Six static storage-contract tests protecting RLS, ownership, approval, settlement, fulfillment, append-only evidence, and safe timeline projection.
Pack 04 handoff, verification record, and next-gate contract.
